source: Registry-linked official school websites, checked against current official organization identity
coverage: Every registry-linked website in the inventory was attempted. Only published full names with explicit classroom teaching roles, verified organization association and current general-education license are eligible. A missing subject stays empty, without guessing. Identical rosters across organizations are held for review. This is not a nationwide personnel census or a guarantee of present employment; inaccessible/ambiguous sources and unsupported formats require review. No phone numbers, emails, photos, personal biographies, degrees or ratings are imported.

fieldNormalization.method: Remove explicit trailing qualification-category and publication-consent annotations; retain published subject prefixes and original evidence/check times. Older identities are not modified. No subjects are inferred.
